title: SheetPair
description: One before-frame matched to one after-frame (docs/contracts/r1.md §1 도곽 짝, §3 `sheet_pair`). Either side may be missing: a sheet only in the after set is `added`, only in the before set is `removed`. Every comparison artefact -- the compare DXF, the `clusters.json` sidecar, one markup DWG -- is produced per pair. Serialised by `GET /compare/sets/{id}/pairs`, which embeds the two frame summaries.

id.description: `sheet_pair` row id. Also the directory name under `.halo/compare/`.

before_frame_id.description: Null when the sheet exists only in the after set (`status = "added"`).

after_frame_id.description: Null when the sheet exists only in the before set (`status = "removed"`).

score.description: Confidence of the match, 0..1. Null for a manual pair and for an unmatched sheet.

sort_key.description: Stable ordering key for the sheet list: normalised drawing number, falling back to the file name plus `sort_index`.

change_count.description: Total `change` rows for this pair, sizeable ones and minor ones together.

minor_count.description: How many of `change_count` were folded as minor (`compare.yaml` `minor`). A pair whose changes are all minor is still `changed`, but its review screen defaults to hiding them.

cluster_count.description: Cloud marks that would be drawn for this pair -- minor changes are not clustered.

compare_dxf_path.description: `.halo/compare/<pair_id>/compare.dxf`, absolute. Null until the pair has been compared.

clusters_json_path.description: `.halo/compare/<pair_id>/clusters.json`, absolute. Null until the pair has been compared.

warnings.description: Non-fatal findings from matching and comparison, as message codes (e.g. `offset_only`, `frame_size_differs`). The UI renders them from `compare.sheets.warning.*`.

before_frame.description: Frame summary embedded by `GET /compare/sets/{id}/pairs` so the list needs no second request.

after_frame.description: Frame summary for the after side.

pair_status.title: PairStatus
pair_status.description: `pending` matched but not compared yet, `changed` at least one non-minor change, `same` no change beyond the minor fold, `added` only in the after set, `removed` only in the before set, `unpaired` several equally good candidates so the user has to pair it by hand, `unrecognized` the file produced no title block, `converter_mismatch` the two sides were converted by different converters and must not be compared (docs/contracts/r1.md §3).

match_method.title: MatchMethod
match_method.description: How the two frames were paired: by normalised drawing `number`, by `title` similarity, by `position` fingerprint, or `manual` when the user paired them on screen B.
